metadata.title: Kelp canopy measurements at 14 sites on the south coast of Vancouver Island, summers 2022-2023
author: J. Moreau (Department of Biology, University of Victoria)
A. Singh (Department of Biology, University of Victoria)
metadata.description: Kelp canopy area measurements recorded by kayak at 14 coastal sites on southern Vancouver Island during the summers of 2022 and 2023, with site coordinates and field observations from each visit.
subject: Earth and Environmental Sciences
metadata.geographic_coverage: South coast of Vancouver Island, British Columbia

checklist.reason: Files are listed but there is no explanation of how they relate or how the data was produced.
Variables are named but have no definitions or units (e.g. canopy_area, temp).
Data is in XLSX and notes are in DOCX; CSV and PDF/A or TXT are preferred.
'Field Notes Final v2.docx' contains spaces and a version label.
Ecological field data with no indication of human participants.
Sites may be on Indigenous territories; the material does not say whether this was considered.
No license or terms of use are stated.
Collection by kayak is mentioned, but not how canopy area was measured.

top_fixes: Add definitions and units for every variable.
Describe how canopy area and temperature were measured.
Convert kelp_sites.xlsx to CSV and the field notes to PDF/A or TXT, and rename files without spaces.
State a license and a point of contact.
